oneLiner: After a successful production deploy, the API sends one formatted summary message to the team Slack webhook.
requirementSummary: OPS-12: when deploy pipeline marks production green, notify #deploys in Slack with service name, version, and deployer—no retries UI, no PagerDuty.

integration.summary: Deploy hook handler reads `SLACK_DEPLOY_WEBHOOK_URL` from env, builds a JSON payload, and POSTs once on `deploy.succeeded` events from the internal bus.
integration.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Bus[deploy.succeeded event] --> Handler[DeployNotifyHandler]
  Handler --> Slack[Slack incoming webhook]
integration.mermaidSequence:
sequenceDiagram
  participant CI as deploy pipeline
  participant API as platform-api
  participant Slack
  CI->>API: POST /internal/hooks/deploy
  API->>Slack: POST webhook JSON
  Slack-->>API: 200 ok

agentConsiderations.question: Use Slack SDK vs raw webhook?
agentConsiderations.resolution: Incoming webhook only—no OAuth bot; matches ticket scope.

agentConsiderations.question: Retry failed Slack POST?
agentConsiderations.resolution: Single attempt; deploy already succeeded; ops reads logs if needed.

worthMentioning: Webhook URL is secret—must live in env/secrets manager, not git.
Handler is fire-and-forget; does not block deploy pipeline response.

humanValidation.headline: Confirm one Slack message per successful prod deploy and no secret in repo.
correctSignals: Staging deploy with test webhook receives exactly one message with version + actor.
Missing webhook URL: handler logs warning, hook returns 204 (deploy not failed).
Invalid shared secret on hook returns 401.
redFlags: Webhook URL committed in config files.
Slack errors bubble up as 500 to CI (blocks deploy).
Multiple messages per single deploy event.

quickChecks.passIf: One Slack message; CI hook returns 2xx
No crash; warn log; CI still 2xx

planBaseline: Env-based URL + shared secret on hook

implementationChronicle.decisionOrConsequence: New handler module only; no new service

inScope: Slack notify on prod deploy success

requirementsTraceability.evidence: Handler formats channel message and POSTs webhook on prod-only flag

behavior.before: Deploy success silent; team checks CI manually.
behavior.after: Prod deploy success triggers optional Slack post when webhook configured.

humanAttention: Confirm prod-only gating matches your pipeline labels.
Rotate webhook if it ever leaked in logs.

coveredByAgent: Secret scan: no webhook in diff

humanChecklist: Failure to Slack does not fail deploy
AC1–AC2 evidence matches what I expect
